author: Subscriptor
body:
No, i'm not banned. However yesterday something happened that has caught my attention and made me make this. 
My other account is IAmRaging (EricV4, ElectraXdroid, etc) is known for having lots of infractions. I have an explaination for that, I know it might be not acceptable as an appeal but oh well. 
Lots of my infractions are false. I cannot prove it, but I'm going to state my opinion and give explaination. 
English is not my main language. I learnt fluent english through minecraft, and going on teamspeak / skype. I only knew basic words in english for example cat dog whatever they teach in school, but not really well. This is my first server iv'e been on. When I logged on, I was so surprised that you could play with other people and it looked amazing to me (it was my first video game as well). I barely knew how to read english or speak or write, therefore I did not pay any attention to the chat or anything on the screen. (I joined avicus firstly 2 weeks after buying minecraft, after i discovered multiplayer but did not understand how to play). Most of my infraction have the same expalination, I simply did not understand the warn. I know, I realize it's not your fault, every player that logs on should abide the rules and its on his responsibility, however I did not even know how to speak/write/read in english until i started going on the avicus teamspeak, took me 2 years to learn fluent, and still not the best at it. Simple as that, a red message appears on my screen saying "youve been warned made no sense for me", i did not even know about the existance of rules. Until summer of 2014 which I flew to USA with my family for around 2 weeks and it helped me a bit with the english, I did not understand anything. Basically i'm not blaming that on you, but every infraction until somewhere around that point I did not understand anything about it. So i kind of kept repeating the same mistakes over and over until I got banned, and I did not even understand why. That happened fairly long time ago and i dont understand why is it still so important if you know the reason for it.
Then, after a while, I started going on teamspeak, I learnt fluent english after a period of time. 

That's for it. After some time I got banned for autoclicking. Not gonna lie, I would admit if I did hack because it's just a block game, but I  never autoclicked. I get around 6-7 clicks per second and sometimes 8 while super tryharding. The story is pretty much I autoclicked in kohi and uploaded a video with that just for laughs (I understand it was stupid) which I assume made staff suspect that I might be autoclicking in Avicus as well. I'll clear that up for you, I've never hacked on Avicus. I did and will keep playing legit because I like this server and I wish stay playing here. 

In between of these I got excessive infractions bans but as i said before most of them are because the first infractions caused of lack of knowledge in English. 
After some time my mojang account went weird and I thought my account was compromised so I asked javi to ban it to prevent trouble, I guess that does not count as an infraction. 
Now about that account. 
Going on teamspeak granted me my wish that is as well important for life and not only for video games, talking almost fluent english. I still have grammar mistakes, however talking fluent english gave me the opportunity to discuss my infractions with staff, communicate properly and even write this appeal.
I talked with Pelpelajax about an infraction I got some time ago from SirCyanide for "watch your language". After I talked with cyanide we understood it was a mistake, because legoche had to go so he messaged cyanide warn 'x' for watch your language and he tabbed the name wrong, you can check the logs from then, I did not use any rude language. Yes, I understand I sometimes use bad language and that, and i'll try to decrease the amount of cursing in the chat.
Then yesterday, SpookLeeGuy warned me because apparently I wasn't nice to other players. It was all a big mistake, because there is an inside joke between me and ZeroTheZombie saying "I'll bomb your house". It's not anywhere conntected to racism or anything, it's just a joke. I went on teamspeak and me and SpookLee argued on that untill we understood it's pointless so I told him what happened. I basically copy a message while typing right before I am about to die, so when I respawn I can paste it. Before that, I copied the message "I'll bomb your house". After understanding all this was stupid, i was going to write an apology message to SpookLee. Then it turned out I pasted the wrong message from my clipboard, made me sending the message "I'll bomb your house" to him.. How stupid it sounds, i was just extremely unlucky. I went on teamspeak and explained him what happened and he says he understands and he made a mistake. He said he will ask it to be removed. 

The point of this appeal is me being tired of staff constantly warning me for "if you get one more infraction you'll be banned" while I dont think they understand the fact that most of them aren't right in my opinion. I hope you understand my point of view.

Thanks and excuse me for grammar mistakes, 

Eric
